mapper.insert: INSERT INTO operation_log (admin_id, action, method, request_path, detail) VALUES (#{adminId}, #{action}, #{method}, #{requestPath}, #{detail})
mapper.select: SELECT l.id, l.admin_id, a.username AS admin_username, l.action, l.method, l.request_path, l.detail, l.created_at FROM operation_log l LEFT JOIN `admin` a ON a.id = l.admin_id ORDER BY l.created_at DESC, l.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
